versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion (below) is the ONLY machine-checked version field — extraction/verify_all.py fails the run if it drifts from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json's own allowlistVersion. repositoryVersion and pageSpecVersion are documentation-only, hand-maintained markers with nothing automatically checking them — do not treat them as an enforcement guarantee.

sourceProject.description: Pixel-fidelity clone of https://rollups.com — React 18 + Vite + Tailwind CSS v3 + GSAP + lottie-web + react-router-dom + Lenis (Consolidate page only), built section-by-section against Playwright measurements of the live site.
sourceProject.note: No absolute or relative filesystem path to the source project is recorded here — see extraction/measured-values.json's citation ledger for build-time evidence sourcing, which degrades gracefully when no sibling source tree is present.

counts.note: Recomputed from disk by extraction/verify_all.py's recompute-and-compare check, not hand-bumped. If this block ever drifts from the real file counts, verify_all.py fails the run (proven via a scratch-copy drift-injection test).
counts.foundationTokenFilesNote: 10 includes tokens/00-foundation/color.signup.json — a documentation-only exception file for the structurally separate /get-started SignUp page, NOT wired into schema/compatibility/allowlist. 9 of the 10 are the enforced marketing-site foundation.

scopeNotes.realContentPages: 13 = the routes with genuine cloned marketing content: /, /ruv, /ruv/calculator, /safe, /how-to-raise-capital, /consolidate, /waitlist, /contact-us, /blog, /blog/:slug (9 real slugs, one template), /privacy-policy, /terms-of-service, /disclosures.
scopeNotes.dummyStubPages: 2 = /careers, /customers — deliberate dummy stops for internal-looking links that don't exist on the live rollups.com sitemap. See templates/templates.json template.placeholder-stub and extraction/measured-values.json.
scopeNotes.separateAppPages: 1 = /get-started (alias /setup) — SignUp page, a structurally separate app clone (app.rollups.com), intentionally excluded from templates.json and the marketing-site token set. See tokens/00-foundation/color.signup.json and extraction/measured-values.json signupPageExclusion.
scopeNotes.totalMountedRoutes: 16 = 13 real + 2 dummy + 1 separate-app, matching src/pages/routes.jsx (15 entries) + src/App.jsx's sibling /get-started route (the /setup path is an alias to the same SignUp component, not counted twice).
